Priyom / Laura — reviewed Maria's redlines and the attached markup. Summary of legal positions and recommended edits:

1) Data retention (requested 30 days -> Acme asked for 365): we cannot stretch to 365 for cache/KV data; propose compromise: 90 days retention for logs/metadata and 30 days for token cache. We will add a carve-out for encrypted customer-provided artifacts.
2) Audit right timing: acceptable with 14 days’ notice; decline the 48-hour request. Add SLA around scope of audit and reimbursable costs.
3) Indemnity and liability cap: we can accept the customer's litigious language if we cap it to 3x fees for the affected order form and carve out willful misconduct.
4) Pricing: we can't provide a standing 12% discount on committed incremental capacity across the board, but can offer either: (A) 8% incremental discount for the first 12 months, or (B) keep list pricing and provide a one-time migration/onboarding credit of $15,000 applied to the first invoice. I recommend option B to keep the contract simpler.

I’ve prepared a tracked redline (attached) with the suggested language and a short comment sheet explaining the compromise points. See: redlines_MSA_acme_v3.docx (Legal v3)

If you want, I can draft the revised order form for signature and a DocuSign envelope. Need sign-off on (a) credit vs discount (pricing) and (b) phased ramp schedule (dates).

— Karthik
